description: Spec defines per-recipient delivery tracking. deliveryReceipts (Object, server-set): keyed by recipient ChatContact.id, each DeliveryReceipt has delivered_at, device_delivered_at, read_at, read_disposition. readDisposition (String): 'displayed', 'deleted', or 'processed'. kith has basic deliveredAt/readAt but no per-recipient breakdown or disposition. Spec reference: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md lines 621-624.
title: Implement delivery receipts (deliveryReceipts, readDisposition)
